svg.text: OPTION 3 - GROUND FLOOR (phase 1): 2 bedrooms, living, dining, kitchen opening to a 176 sqft garden
Your layout kept (bedroom 1 at the front, L-shaped living, kitchen then garden then bedroom 2), with passages removed and the stair moved to the west so it lands outside the hall.
ROAD / GATE (NORTH) on the left. Top edge = EAST neighbour house (our new 9" wall). Bottom edge = WEST apartment (existing wall). Right = BACK (existing wall).
Plot 106' long, 21' wide at the road, 20' at the back. Scale drawing. Outer walls 9", partitions 6". Positions are feet from the front boundary.
NEEM TREE: trunk 3'6" from road, 7'6" from west,
leans in to ~8'. Slab above starts at 14'.
EXTERNAL STAIR to hall (phase 2): 4' wide, 18 x 7" risers
store room under the upper half
L counter along east + back wall, door to garden
cupboard wall 2' deep along the stair
Black squares = RCC columns in the side walls (6 per side). Beams span the full 19'. The hall above is column-free.
